v8 cut for issues #99 and #104 (input accounting), as corrected by pre-push review: daemons/pty-runner.mjs accounts for a C0 control EXECUTED inside an unfinished control sequence (ECMA-48 5.4 / DEC STD 070) instead of absorbing it as a parameter byte. Such a control taints with the byte named printably, and a CR BOOKS the transcript record it may owe as an uncertain submission -- but only when the host could actually have submitted: a CR whose pre-sequence byte before the cursor was a backslash is the documented composer newline and owes nothing, and a CR on a composer that was empty and clean changes nothing and is neither booked nor tainted, so neither leaves a phantom FIFO entry to absorb the next genuine receipt. A booked mid-sequence CR is forced NOT `certain`, which _uncertainSubmission would otherwise derive from the previous record and which reopened #99 in a narrower shape. A receipt settles a submission WITHOUT discarding an unfinished parser state or its restore snapshot: confirmSubmission leaves mode/sequence/activeControl alone while a sequence is in flight and re-points the ESC-arrival snapshot at the confirmed state, so automatic input stays deferred until the sequence completes and an inert completion then releases it on the receipt already held, with no further operator Enter and no fabricated receipt. The ESC-arrival snapshot is otherwise poisoned so no restore path can put the pre-report state back over any of this. A bracketed paste carrying more than its own end-marker ESC no longer adopts an interleaved terminal report's trailing byte as the byte before the cursor. _disableAutomation emits automation-disabled on entry or on a change of effective reason rather than on every poll, compared on the UNTRUNCATED reason, with the per-tick cancellation work left deliberately unconditional. daemons/pty-runner.mjs is the ONLY pinned file that moved relative to the previous baseline.
